subject: reasoning
question: If each letter of the word DAUGHTER is arranged in English alphabetical order, then how many letters will remain unchanged in their positions?
solution:
The logic follows here,

Given Word : D A U G H T E R

 Arranged in English alphabetical order : A D E G H R T U

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd76554974796ca979fa943cd9274a184088890dd3a1ffc7443dda0466da7dec.png] 

Two letters will remain unchanged : G and H.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
